$comment: Download manifest for InterForge models + curated LoRAs. No weights are committed to the repo; entries are fetched on first use (or by the installer) into MODELS_ROOT. See LICENSES.md at the repo root for redistribution terms. hf_repo entries download via huggingface_hub; hf_file entries are a single file within a repo.

checkpoints.label: Stable Diffusion XL
checkpoints.note: Neutral base — the shipped default; the cleanest LoRA canvas.

checkpoints.label: SSD-1B (fast)
checkpoints.note: Distilled SDXL — ~2.5 GB, faster; fully-open license.

checkpoints.label: Samaritan 3D Cartoon
checkpoints.note: Cartoon/matte — best for meshes. Un-gated; download on the user's machine. Do NOT bundle weights without verifying redistribution rights.

loras.label: Pixel Art XL
loras.note: Best-known pixel-art SDXL LoRA. Redistributable (carry use-restrictions).

loras.label: Pixar Style (toon)
loras.note: Toon/3D style — steers base SDXL toward clean, mesh-friendly silhouettes.

loras.label: Crayon / Hand-drawn
loras.note: Illustrated hand-drawn look. Fully-open Apache license.
